name: Shimano seven-speed cassette (E group)
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 325 g for the seven-speed E-group 12–28T CS-HG90 sprockets and spacers. Lockring inclusion is assumed under the weight guidelines. This is distinct from the existing I-group 13–23T reference, whose conflicting weight remains unknown.
